ev.q: In 2020, 12.3% of men and 29.0% of women aged ≥18 years always used sunscreen when outside on a sunny day for >1 hour.
The percentage of women who always used sunscreen was lower among those aged 18–29 and ≥65 years (25.7% and 27.7%, respectively)
For every age group, women were more likely than men to always use sunscreen.
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.

methods_quotes.q: * With 95% CIs indicated by error bars.
Approximately 2.5% of adults who answered that they do not go outside on a sunny day for >1 hour were excluded from the analysis.
